Meta.title: Voon Business – AI workspace for SMEs
Meta.description: AI tools for everyday business: quotes, emails, marketing, hiring, meeting notes, automation, funding and EU AI Act checks – in Finnish, Swedish and English.

Landing.title: Stop guessing.
Landing.subtitle: Voon Business brings a secure AI co-worker to your company: it writes quotes and emails, plans marketing, drafts job ads, summarises meetings, finds funding and spots automation opportunities – based on your own company profile.
Landing.problemText: Everyone talks about AI, but in a small company there is little time to try it and data security worries. Voon Business turns AI into ready-made, safe tools for the work you already do every week.
Landing.toolsTitle: One workspace for the whole business
Landing.toolsSubtitle: Every tool knows your company profile, writes in your language and saves the results to your shared library.
Landing.howTitle: From sign-up to results in minutes
Landing.step1Text: Fill in a short company profile once. Every AI tool uses it as context.
Landing.step2Title: Pick a tool or ask the advisor
Landing.step2Text: Fill in a few fields or just ask – the AI answers in Finnish, Swedish or English.
Landing.step3Text: Copy the result, save it to the library and share it with your team.
Landing.healthText: Answer 12 questions and get a score for operations, digital maturity, innovation, finances and risk – with three prioritised recommendations and a PDF report.
Landing.healthPoint1: Five-area score and trend over time
Landing.healthPoint3: AI advisor that knows your results
Landing.trust1Text: Each company's data is isolated, and access is limited to your own team.
Landing.trust2Text: The AI marks assumptions in [brackets] so you always know what to check.
Landing.trust3Text: Designed with the GDPR and the EU AI Act in mind – and a tool that helps you check your own AI use.
Landing.pricingTitle: Start free, grow when you're ready
Landing.pricingSubtitle: Prices excl. VAT. Cancel any time.
Landing.ecosystemTitle: Part of the VOON IQ family
Landing.ecosystemText: Voon Business is the business tool of VOON IQ, an AI startup from Jyväskylä. Our other services cover marketing, skills and careers.
Landing.faq1a: No. Each tool is a short form, and the advisor works like a chat. If you can write an email, you can use Voon Business.
Landing.faq2a: The whole service and every AI result is available in Finnish, Swedish and English.
Landing.faq3q: Is our data used to train AI models?
Landing.faq3a: No. We use the AI provider through its business API, where submitted data is not used for model training by default.
Landing.faq4a: Yes. That's why results are drafts for you to review, and assumptions are clearly marked. Legal and funding tools remind you to verify the details.
Landing.ctaTitle: Give your team an AI co-worker today
Landing.ctaText: Free to start. No credit card needed.
